relations: The lifted boot lowers to the floor as her weight shifts onto the planted leg.
The free arm bends inward toward the chest, then extends outward as her stance widens.
Her feet transition through a crossed position to a wider stance, mirrored on the glass.
One arm rises bent near her face while the other crosses her torso, reflected in the mirror.
caption:
The video captures a white dance studio with a light floor, dark ceiling spotlights, an air-conditioning unit, a sheer curtain, and a mirror wall. A woman with a long dark ponytail, denim sleeveless top, dark pleated skirt, and black thigh-high heeled boots stands left of center, facing the glass. Her frontal reflection appears clearly in the large mirror. One boot is lifted behind her, knee bent, while one arm extends straight toward the mirror. The lifted foot lowers as she shifts her weight.

The free arm draws in with a bent elbow, hand gesturing near the chest. It later opens outward to the side as her stance widens. Her feet move through an offset, crossed position and then settle into a wider stance. In the visible later movement, one arm rises bent near her face while the other bends across her torso. The mirror reproduces these changes as a frontal image, with small adjustments continuing throughout.
